title: Denormal IEEE-754 FP32 Simulated Addition Bypassing CUDA Core ALU Contention

claims.assertion: For non-negative integers x, y <= 2^22, the bitwise integer addition result x + y is identical to treating their 32-bit patterns as IEEE-754 denormal floats and executing a floating-point addition: __float_as_uint(__uint_as_float(x) + __uint_as_float(y)). DeepSelect uses this to replace integer additions, bypassing ALU resource contention with bitwise/comparison instructions and achieving 2x throughput over integer multiply-add.
